title: Emoji were 12 by 12 pixels, designed for pagers
body: Shigetaka Kurita's 1999 emoji set for NTT DoCoMo had 176 glyphs at 12x12 pixels, meant to add emotion and weather icons to tiny screens. Adopted into Unicode in 2010, they became a global writing layer. Their constraints, tiny grids on pagers, still shape the flat pictorial style.
source_hint: NTT DoCoMo i-mode emoji set (1999); Unicode 6.0
